# yellow3 lab
> AI Research Lab - Copenhagen, Denmark

## Overview

yellow3 lab is an AI research lab based in Copenhagen, Denmark. Founded by Thomas Christian Melskens. We research and develop autonomous AI platforms.

## What We Do

yellow3 lab researches markets where important change is happening, publishes what it measures, and builds a platform when the research exposes a problem software can solve better. We focus on five research areas, the same five the site itself lists:

- Outcome Architecture: designing systems that start with the end in mind.
- Human-Direction AI: AI that amplifies human judgment, not replaces human thinking.
- Autonomous Software: software that plans, decides, and executes with reliability.
- Digital Product Passports: how regulation, product data, evidence and supplier capabilities are reshaping the market. https://www.yellow3.io/research/digital-product-passport
- AI-native SMB Infrastructure: the next generation of infrastructure for small and mid-sized businesses. https://www.yellow3.io/research/model-adoption

The research is published as live instruments rather than opinion: original measurement, dated, with the method and the sources stated. https://www.yellow3.io/research

## Our Philosophy

The best technology is the technology you forget is there. Technology promised to empower everyone. Instead, it created a priesthood - developers, consultants, agencies - standing between people and their ideas. We think that's broken. So we're fixing it.

## Platforms

yellow3 lab researches markets where important change is happening, and builds a platform when that research exposes a problem software can solve better. Problem, research, platform, outcome - in that order.

URL: https://www.yellow3.io/platforms

- DPP Supplier Register: an independent public research database and global supplier register for Digital Product Passport capability. Free to use. Suppliers cannot pay to appear differently, rank higher or improve an assessment. https://www.yellow3.io/research/digital-product-passport/suppliers
- DPP Buyer Platform: a private buyer-side operating platform for organisations planning, buying and implementing Digital Product Passport capability. yellow3 lab does not operate Digital Product Passports. https://buyer.yellow3.io
- naffe.ai: turns plain-language direction into working software, for people who understand the problem rather than the technology. https://naffe.ai
